scope: Native pedometer configuration repair, bounded device observations and serial-reset mitigation; no custom recognition algorithm or daily steps UI
authorization: User requested device testing; initially confirmed USB only, no battery, loose motor wire secured; later selected the original battery for natural walking and confirmed both supplies before arming.

source_inspection.failure: Initial candidate had BSP_USING_I2C3 unset; probe returned accepted=0 before address reads. Board defaults enable I2C1/2/4 only.
source_inspection.repair: Enable I2C3 in Product proj.conf, compile-reject missing BSP_USING_I2C3, report missing bus/configuration failure separately.
source_inspection.unchanged: Native AN5130 register recipe, SDK lock/submodules, generated UI, threshold 0x10 and debounce 0x6e unchanged.

missing_i2c3_guard.diagnostic: Product native IMU diagnostic requires BSP_USING_I2C3

host_validation.new_coverage: Missing bus and configuration failure perform no sensor transfers, release IDLE and allow a later successful probe.

compilation.versions: Python 3.13.15; SCons 4.10.1; Arm GNU Toolchain 14.2.Rel1, GCC 14.2.1
compilation.retained_hook: BSP_PowerUpCustom 0x200033bc in .retm_data; false branch to 0x2000345a returns without Flash calls
compilation.ui_demo: Not rebuilt: no shared core, UI/generated output or UI Demo configuration change.

flash.preflight: Manifest three images, hashes, SDK lock and retained hook checked; DryRun passed before each write. No whole-chip erase or explicit settings partition write.

initial_candidate.sources: 429 raw-byte matches; four new IMU source files differ only in LF/CRLF after Git checkout
initial_candidate.device_result: Startup and early inhibit verified, low-voltage refusal with no battery; probe failed because I2C3 was not registered. No step experiment.

device_observations.probe: Only address 0x6a matched WHO_AM_I=0x6a; 0x6b did not match and the SDK logged NACK/recovery during that address probe. The diagnostic io_errors counter covers owned configuration/counter I/O, not this candidate NACK. Expected part comes from board BOM, not unique WHO identification.
device_observations.first_battery_attempt: Native counter armed for 120s, but reconnection capture contained SFBL, full cold startup, RTC January 2000 and phase=UNPROBED. Cached experiment was lost; sample invalid, no accuracy conclusion.

battery_sample_after_modem_setting.human_reference: 用户澄清按左右脚一组计一次，约30组即约60个单脚步；出门、返回及操作不严谨，完整采样窗口没有独立逐步计数。
battery_sample_after_modem_setting.interpretation: Exploratory only. Preserve raw 70; neither 30 nor an exact 60 is a controlled full-window ground truth. The earlier 10-step/16.7% arithmetic must not be treated as an accuracy result.

serial_reset_investigation.before_setting: Two BAT+USB sessions had zero received bytes even after user confirmed a lit screen; RTS pulse requested in one also yielded no bytes. Transmitted stop/allow commands in these sessions were not acknowledged.
serial_reset_investigation.battery_power_observation: User confirmed screen could display/wake during battery-only walking.
serial_reset_investigation.voltage_causality: Low-VBAT inhibited charging and successful UART/probe/static test coexisted in USB-only sessions. Selected charger paths show no direct UART reconfiguration/reboot call; this does not exclude indirect PM or electrical effects.
serial_reset_investigation.setting: User enabled Disable Modem flow control in COM5 advanced properties; read-only registry confirmed DisableModemOutHandShake=1. The value was absent in the earlier scoped query.
serial_reset_investigation.after_setting: Stable-power open retained RTC and cache; subsequent battery/USB reconnection retained RUNNING start=608256 and native count. Neither capture contained SFBL; no explicit RTS pulse was requested.
serial_reset_investigation.causal_limit: Observed mitigation supports the documented RTS opening mechanism; no oscilloscope trace or exhaustive USB/PM test establishes every reset cause.

record_location: Each session is artifacts/imu-native/<session>/uart.bin, uart-clean.txt and session.json in this workspace; ignored local records, not repository links.

helpers.scope: Whitelisted diagnostic commands, DTR/RTS false before open, explicit RTS requests separately recorded. Offline detach skips stop only after verified RUNNING; releases console PM hold and closes UART. Default close attempts stop/allow/status independently.

final_state.conditions: Last user-confirmed original battery plus USB; motor wire secured. No manual charger/motor commands. Existing automatic USB charging was observed; not a new charging acceptance test.
final_state.limit: Remaining SDK IDLE request is not attributed or measured here; no physical DEEP/current/battery-life claim.

next_bounded_experiment: Agree single-foot counting, fix mounting/orientation and record the complete trial window including handling; repeat native baseline/walking/interference samples before parameter comparison. No custom replacement algorithm authorized by this exploratory sample.
